issue: pump_validate_parallel.py retained one <suite>.log per executed suite with write_text and no newline argument, so newline=None let the host translate the trailing newline and the retained log bytes differed between Windows and the Linux CI.
affected: scripts/pump_validate_parallel.py:250 at base, the retained suite log write
finding: The retained directory is the evidence the driver keeps for each executed suite; its log files were the only text artifacts written without a newline pin. The build/qualification evidence families already pin UTF-8 LF.

change.unchanged_behaviour: suite commands, sharding, timeouts, retained failure outputs, the report payload and every exit status

runs.guard_before: tests/test_validate_parallel_log_encoding.py fails on the base writer (FAILED, failures=1)

cases: every write_text in the driver pins encoding='utf-8' and newline='\n', and exactly one such writer remains

limits: This changes only the bytes of the retained suite logs; it adds no suite, shard or timeout behavior and alters no prior receipt.
